from pathlib import Path
from typing import Final

import pytest

NOTES_DIR: Final = Path("notes")


def read_note(name: str) -> str:
    """Return the text of the file `name` inside NOTES_DIR.

    NOTES_DIR is relative to the current working directory. `name` is
    untrusted: only regular files that resolve to a location inside
    NOTES_DIR are read. A missing, unreadable, non-file, or outside-directory
    name yields "".
    """
    try:
        base = NOTES_DIR.resolve()
        target = (base / name).resolve()
        if not target.is_relative_to(base) or not target.is_file():
            return ""
        return target.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError):
        return ""


def test_reads_plain_file(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "a.txt").write_text("hello", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note("a.txt") == "hello"


def test_reads_nested_file_inside_notes(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub" / "b.txt").write_text("nested", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note("sub/b.txt") == "nested"


def test_missing_file_gives_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    assert read_note("nope.txt") == ""


def test_directory_name_gives_empty(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "dir").mkdir(parents=True)
    assert read_note("dir") == ""


def test_parent_traversal_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note("../secret.txt") == ""


def test_nested_traversal_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "sub").mkdir(parents=True)
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note("sub/../../secret.txt") == ""


def test_absolute_path_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    assert read_note(str(secret.resolve())) == ""


def test_symlink_escaping_notes_blocked(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    (tmp_path / "notes").mkdir()
    secret = tmp_path / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("top secret", encoding="utf-8")
    (tmp_path / "notes" / "link.txt").symlink_to(secret)
    assert read_note("link.txt") == ""
